name: Necrotech Adept
body:
Prerequisite(s): Humanoid, monstrous humanoid, aberration, dragon, or plant; non-good alignment.

Benefit(s): You use your Charisma in place of your Constitution score to determine your Fortitude save and you do not take a penalty to your hit points if your Constitution modifier is negative. You are also treated as a construct for the purposes of being able to take the necrotech master archetype and for its effects.

Special: This feat must be taken at 1st level. Your Constitution score is permanently lowered by 2 points. If your Constitution score is 2 or lower, you cannot select this feat.
